verifier_source:
require 'json'
require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(ARGV.fetch(0))
r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/report.json'))
raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'
keys=%w[kind counter width snapshot calls mode]
cases=%w[array dictionary].product(%w[captured argument],[128,2048],%w[once fresh],[16,32])
raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm interpreter jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
r['identities'].each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Embedded source hash' unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)==h}
(r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
 dir=o+'/'+x.values_at(*keys.first(5)).join('-')
 {'source_sha256'=>'main.kujo','module_sha256'=>'owner.kujo'}.each{|k,p|raise 'Actual fixture drift' unless r['sources'].key?(x[k])&&Digest::SHA256.file(dir+'/'+p).hexdigest==x[k]}
 raise 'Semantic failure' if x.key?('exit')&&x['exit']!=0
end
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('kind','counter','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |group,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']}
 {'group'=>group,'calls'=>[a['calls'],b['calls']],'requests'=>(b['requests']-a['requests']).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls']),'bytes'=>(b['bytes']-a['bytes']).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])}
end
raise 'Slope arithmetic' unless slopes==r['slopes']
penalties=slopes.group_by{|x|g=x['group'];[g[0],g[1],g[3],g[4]]}.map do |group,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['group'][2]}
 {group:group,widths:[a['group'][2],b['group'][2]],extra_requests_per_call:b['requests']-a['requests'],extra_bytes_per_call:b['bytes']-a['bytes']}
end
receipt={status:'characterized',allocation_observations:64,semantic_checks:96,slopes:slopes,width_penalties:penalties,report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(o+'/report.json').hexdigest,verifier_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,limits:'Baseline allocation characterization; no candidate speed or regression acceptance.'}
File.write(o+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(receipt)+"\n")
puts JSON.pretty_generate(receipt)
limits: Current accepted runtime baseline, not candidate acceptance or clean-host speed evidence.
